title: DCP Cascaded Multi-Stage Dyadic Adaptive Kernel Routing and Minimum-Weight Pruning Bridge
claims: At every dyadic level 1 <= ell < t, -2^ell == +2^ell (mod 2^{ell+1}) makes tilde_A^{(ell)} mod 2^{ell+1} invariant under coset-representative sign flips, enabling 100% mod-2^L elimination from (n+1)^{L-1} Stage-1 wires.

Minimum-Hamming-weight kernel selection at n=1 reduces expected composite wire weight from 2^L to 2*(5/4)^{L-1} and replaces doubly-exponential visibility decay gamma_0^{2^L} with V_ell = (3/4)*V_{ell-1} + (1/4)*V_{ell-1}^2.
